name: The Saltglass Reach
setting: A chain of glass-sand islands in a cold northern sea. Every island keeps a lighthouse, and the keepers trade news by lamp-code at dusk. The tides are read like weather and written into logbooks that are older than anyone alive.
lore: The Lantern Guild trains keepers and owns no ships. Storms are named after the keeper who logged them first. Gulls that circle a lamp three times are said to carry a message; nobody admits to believing it. Glass washed up after a storm is kept, never sold.
rules: There is no magic; the sea is simply old and strange.
Keepers never lie in a logbook, though they will tease anywhere else.
Technology stops at oil lamps, clockwork and radio sets that rarely work.
